build_densenet_model: build a DenseNet model with configurable num_blocks, growth_rate, and expansion parameters for image classification
create_densenet_from_config: create a DenseNet instance from a config dictionary using the from_config class method
build_dense_layer: build a _DenseLayer with batch norm, 1x1 conv, 3x3 conv, and optional squeeze-and-excitation
build_transition_layer: build a _Transition layer with batch norm, 1x1 conv, and average pooling to reduce spatial resolution
run_densenet_forward: run a forward pass through the DenseNet model on input tensor x to get feature output
